label: Release triage
title: Start with the blockers.
prompt: Which open defects could block Release 2.4? Group them by severity and show who owns the next step.

calls.detail: Query defects in the chosen project and release; page through the results.
Read each candidate’s severity, owner and current status.

result: Example: 8 open defects, 2 critical, 3 without an owner. A short triage list with item IDs, links and missing information to check.
guard: Read-only review. Ask for approval before proposing any reassignment or status change.

label: Document review
title: Turn a vague requirement into a proposal.
prompt: Review the requirements in the Brake Control LiveDoc. Rewrite REQ-17 so its acceptance criteria are measurable. Preview the change first.

calls.detail: Locate the referenced work items in the document.
Read REQ-17 and its current description.
dry_run: true · preview the proposed description update.

result: Example: a proposed REQ-17 description, the assumptions behind the rewrite, and a preview of the PATCH request. Nothing has been saved.
guard: You review the proposal. Only after approval does the assistant repeat the update without dry_run. This edits the requirement, not arbitrary LiveDoc body text.

label: Test preparation
title: From requirements to a test record.
prompt: Draft test cases for these requirements and prepare a test run. After I execute them, record the results I provide. Preview all writes first.

calls.detail: Read the selected requirements and check existing test cases first.
dry_run: true · draft test case items using the project’s configured types.
dry_run: true · preview the new test run.
After execution and approval, record the supplied outcomes; preview first.

result: Example: 4 draft test cases and a run proposal. After you execute the tests and provide outcomes, the assistant can record those results in Polarion.
guard: Approve each write after its preview. The connector records results; it does not execute your product tests or infer a pass.

label: Release status
title: Bring evidence to the status meeting.
prompt: Summarize the Release 2.4 plan: unfinished work, owners, open defects and the latest test runs. Flag anything the data cannot answer.

calls.detail: Read the chosen plan and its scheduled item relationships.
Read the scheduled items and release defects.
Read matching run status and available result fields.

result: Example: 12 unfinished items, 2 blocking defects and 1 unfinished run, with source IDs and a list of missing data. A draft meeting update you can check.
guard: Read-only summary. You decide whether the release is ready; the assistant does not approve or close it.

label: Traceability gaps
title: Find the missing links before the review.
prompt: For the requirements in this release, find those without a verifies link to a test case. Check existing items before proposing new tests.

calls.detail: Fetch the agreed requirement scope and any candidate test cases.
Inspect each requirement’s links and the project’s link direction.

result: Example: 6 requirements without the expected test link. Existing candidate tests are listed separately from requirements that may need a new test.
guard: Read-only gap list. Review the project’s link roles and scope before approving any new item or link.
